stud_validation.method: Fit body corners only; predict polygon centroids of radius6 LDU stud-top discs at y=-4 (world body origin), using 256 projected circumference points; compare native thresholded cap fill centroids. No cap fitted to camera. Threshold repetitions are sensitivity, not independent observations.
stud_validation.pixel_aspect_correction: Native y coordinates multiplied by PDF placement sy/sx before fitting/prediction; source raster itself unmodified for measurement.

limitations: Two selected illustrations from two Classic2024 books, not a representative theme sample
Corner thresholds and leave-one-corner-out fits are sensitivity checks, not independent camera observations
Full intrinsic/optical parameters remain ill-conditioned; local direction from body center is more stable
Stud top circle and body geometry assume nominal standard dimensions
Pinhole is not uniformly better in leave-one-corner-out error; white brick is a near tie
